scenario: Production warehouse inventory cutover from a legacy COBOL packed-decimal movement feed into a restartable Python equivalence runtime with dynamic record layouts, weighted inventory accounting, reconciliation and atomic publication.

root_cause_clusters.RC-PACKED: Packed-decimal field-domain rules are collapsed into permissive generic nibble handling.
root_cause_clusters.RC-LAYOUT: Dynamic COBOL storage geometry is treated as linear fixed storage instead of bounded overlays/ODO framing.
root_cause_clusters.RC-RESTART: Generation identity and checkpoint semantics do not fence exact durable progress.
root_cause_clusters.RC-POLICY: Business eligibility is validated incompletely before accounting.
root_cause_clusters.RC-ACCOUNTING: Inventory quantity/value invariants are weaker than weighted-cost movement semantics.
root_cause_clusters.RC-CONTROLS: Reconciliation/publication controls self-validate or fail to gate official output.
root_cause_clusters.RC-DURABILITY: Persistent uniqueness and repeat-publication semantics do not enforce exactly-once state.

defects.observable_failure: Non-zero COMP-3 storage padding is silently normalized instead of rejected.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Fixing digit validation alone still permits corrupted storage padding.

defects.observable_failure: Packed decimal digit nibble A is accepted as a numeric digit.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Sign validation does not prevent an invalid data nibble from corrupting the value.

defects.observable_failure: A signed COMP-3 field accepts unsigned F as its sign nibble.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A global set of accepted signs cannot enforce signed field semantics.

defects.observable_failure: An unsigned COMP-3 field accepts signed C/D sign conventions.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Encoding fixes are insufficient while decoding still ignores the field sign domain.

defects.observable_failure: Unsigned packing emits signed C and does not reject negative input.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Changing only the emitted positive sign still leaves negative unsigned values encodable.

defects.observable_failure: Negative signed packing emits C instead of D and loses the negative sign on round trip.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Decoder correctness cannot recover a sign that the encoder discarded.

defects.observable_failure: Caller-supplied --layout paths are replaced by the built-in layout unless the basename matches.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Changing layout IDs in tests is insufficient unless semantic alternate layouts are actually loaded.

defects.observable_failure: REDEFINES storage is added to static record length instead of overlaying its target.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Offset fixes alone do not repair the static geometry exposed by describe-layout.

defects.observable_failure: ODO counts above the declared maximum are accepted when resolving dynamic record structure.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Checking only for negative counts permits oversized dynamic fields and framing drift.

defects.observable_failure: REDEFINES offsets start at the current cursor and advance it instead of sharing target storage.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Static length can look correct while runtime offsets still consume duplicate storage.

defects.observable_failure: A determinable malformed complete record reports only the partial decode cursor as byte_length.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Recovery can identify the next record only when complete malformed records preserve their actual boundary.

defects.observable_failure: Generation IDs omit the layout digest, allowing semantic layout changes to retain the same generation ID.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Source identity alone cannot fence layout-dependent record interpretation.

defects.observable_failure: Resume compatibility ignores layout digest changes.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A generation ID check cannot compensate when the ID itself historically omitted layout identity.

defects.observable_failure: Checkpoint source/layout/date fingerprints are not validated before resume.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Matching generation IDs do not prove the exact input generation is unchanged.

defects.observable_failure: Resume starts at the last durable sequence instead of the next sequence.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Deduplication may mask some replay effects but does not repair checkpoint semantics.

defects.observable_failure: Already processed movement IDs are not skipped during replay.
defects.partial_fix_trap: A correct resume offset still needs durable duplicate protection against repeated input.

defects.observable_failure: Zero-quantity movements are accepted as positive business work.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Downstream accounting cannot infer whether a zero movement was intentionally invalid.

defects.observable_failure: Transfers with identical source and destination warehouses are accepted.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Balanced accounting does not make a same-warehouse transfer a valid movement.

defects.observable_failure: Inactive items are accepted for movement processing.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Warehouse validation cannot compensate for item lifecycle state.

defects.observable_failure: Inactive warehouses are accepted for receipts/issues/transfers.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Movement shape validation cannot replace warehouse operational state.

defects.observable_failure: Issues and transfers check only that some source inventory exists, not that requested quantity is available.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Negative-state guards occur too late and are themselves permissive in the starter.

defects.observable_failure: Issue valuation uses the movement unit cost instead of the weighted source inventory unit cost.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Quantity correctness can coexist with financially wrong inventory depletion.

defects.observable_failure: Transfer destination value is calculated from movement unit cost instead of preserving source value.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Matching transfer quantities are insufficient when transfer value is not conserved.

defects.observable_failure: Post-effect validation permits negative inventory quantity/value within broad starter thresholds.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Pre-checks do not cover every effect application path or race boundary.

defects.observable_failure: Effect count reconciliation compares the actual count to itself instead of the legacy control.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Other totals can match while a missing or duplicated effect escapes the close gate.

defects.observable_failure: Transfer imbalance reconciliation compares the imbalance count to itself instead of zero.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Net generation totals can hide a per-transfer imbalance.

defects.observable_failure: Failed reconciliation can still enter the publication path.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Run state alone is not a publication authorization boundary.

defects.observable_failure: Re-publishing the same verified generation raises a collision instead of returning the existing publication.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Exactly-once restart requires recognizing the already-published identical generation.

defects.observable_failure: Durable processed/reject/effect tables lack generation-scoped uniqueness needed to fence sequence/effect replay.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Application-level replay checks are not a last line of defense against retries or races.

anti_padding_attestation: All counted environment modules implement reachable warehouse cutover, storage, state, recovery, accounting, control or publication responsibilities. Tests, solution, documentation and generated runtime state are excluded from the solver-visible LOC floor.
